meta.title: Stash — Save anything. Find it by meaning.
meta.description: Every post, page and screenshot you keep, in one library on your Mac. Search by meaning, on-device.
hero.news: Semantic search now runs on WebGPU
hero.sub: Every post, page and screenshot you keep, in one library on your Mac. Describe what you remember and Stash finds it.
search.pillExample: that latte with the heart in a blue cup
hero.videoLabel: The Stash library: saved posts on the globe view, with filters and search by meaning
feature.globe.title: Globe view
feature.globe.text: Every snip on one sphere. Spin it, filter it, fall into it.
feature.filters.title: Instant filters
feature.filters.text: Posts, screenshots, notes and links — one keystroke apart.
feature.model.title: EmbeddingGemma
feature.model.text: A local model reads what you save. Nothing leaves the Mac.
sources.lead: Pulls from the places good ideas already live — X, every Chromium browser, your screen
how.text: Folders and tags take work, so most bookmarks never get looked at again. Stash reads each snip as you save it, so the thing you half-remember turns up in milliseconds.
how.capture.title: Capture in one keystroke
how.capture.text: Save a post, a page or a region of your screen from anywhere. X bookmarks sync on their own.
how.search.title: Search by meaning
how.search.text: Describe it the way you remember it. Ranked results in about 2 ms, even with no exact keyword.
how.private.title: Private by default
how.private.text: Embeddings run locally on Apple Silicon. Your library stays yours — no account needed.
reader.title: Every snip opens exactly as you saved it.
reader.p1.text: Media, threads and replies, archived even if the original gets deleted.
reader.p2.text: ← → moves through every match without losing your place.
reader.p3.text: Post, copy or open the source in one click.
pricing.title: Free. All of it.
pricing.text: The Mac app and the browser extension are free, with no snip limit and no account. Cloud sync and mobile apps are on the way.
pricing.mac.name: Mac + extension
pricing.cloud.name: Cloud
pricing.mobile.name: Mobile
faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.more: Something else? Open an issue on {github}.
faq.q1: Does anything I save leave my Mac?
faq.a1: No. Indexing and search run on your Mac with EmbeddingGemma on WebGPU. The app downloads the model once; your snips are never uploaded.
faq.q2: How does X bookmark sync work?
faq.a2: The browser extension scrolls your bookmarks once, then only picks up new ones. Bookmarking a post on X also saves it to Stash.
faq.q3: Can I import from Raindrop or Pocket?
faq.a3: Import files from the app's Import menu; dedicated importers are on the list.
faq.a4: Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later.
faq.a5: Coming soon, together with optional cloud sync. The Mac app and the browser extension come first.
final.title: Stop losing the good stuff.
final.sub: Free download. No account, no limits.
